title: Copy class namespace before iteration to avoid free-threaded race conditions
answers: Why does TypeAdapter or model inspection raise RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration in Python 3.14?
How do I safely iterate over class attributes or vars(typ) in free-threaded Python?
What causes concurrent annotation evaluation crashes in LazyLocalNamespace or decorator extraction?
body:
Symptom: RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration when building TypeAdapter instances or constructing models concurrently in free-threaded Python 3.14+.
Root cause: pydantic/_internal/_decorators.py:_decorator_infos_for_class and pydantic/_internal/_namespace_utils.py:LazyLocalNamespace.data iterate over vars(typ) or MappingProxyType namespaces while another thread evaluates annotations, mutating the class dictionary with attributes like __annotations_cache__.
Fix pattern: Snapshot the mapping via .copy() prior to iteration (e.g. vars(typ).copy().items() or ns.copy() if isinstance(ns, MappingProxyType) else ns).
Constraints: Applies to class namespaces and types where concurrent annotation reads can mutate class attributes; unnecessary for thread-confined local dictionaries.
applies: Class namespace inspection and attribute iteration in free-threaded Python environments.
